headline: Mixed Tabs and Spaces
template: On line {line}, tabs and spaces are mixed in indentation. Use 4 spaces consistently for every block.
socratic: Do all lines inside this block start at the exact same space column?

headline: Expected an Indented Block
template: Line {line} needs to be indented. After a colon `:`, shift the next line 4 spaces to the right.
socratic: Which line belongs inside the block after `:`?

headline: Indentation Not Aligned
template: The spacing at the start of line {line} does not match the surrounding block. Align sibling lines with the same number of spaces.
socratic: Compare the leading spaces on line {line} with the lines above it.

headline: Unclosed Quote Mark
template: The string quote on line {line} was never closed. Every text literal needs matching opening and closing quotes, like `"Hello"`.
socratic: Where should the text on line {line} end?

headline: Use `==` to Compare Values
template: Inside the condition on line {line}, use `==` (double equals) to compare values instead of `=`.
socratic: Is line {line} assigning a variable or checking if two values match?

headline: Missing Colon `:`
template: Line {line} needs a colon `:` at the end of the `{keyword}` statement to start its block.
socratic: Which symbol always ends an `if`, `for`, `while`, or `def` header line?

headline: Unclosed Parenthesis or Bracket
template: An opening parenthesis or bracket near line {line} was never closed with `)` or `]`.
socratic: Count the opening and closing brackets on line {line} — do they match?

headline: Extra Closing Bracket
template: Line {line} has a closing `{char}` without a matching opening bracket.
socratic: Which closing bracket on line {line} is extra?

headline: Missing Comma
template: On line {line}, separate each argument or item with a comma `,`.
socratic: Are two values sitting next to each other on line {line} without a comma?

headline: `print` Requires Parentheses `()`
template: In Python 3, `print` needs parentheses on line {line}, for example `print("Hello")`.
socratic: How should you wrap the text inside `print(...)`?

headline: Invalid Name or Statement Placement
template: Line {line} violates Python naming or block placement rules. Variable names must start with a letter or underscore and cannot be keywords.
socratic: Check the variable name or keyword placement on line {line}.

headline: Unrecognized Character
template: Line {line} contains a special character (such as smart quotes `“ ”`). Replace it with straight quotes `"` or `'`.
socratic: Are all punctuation marks on line {line} standard ASCII characters?

headline: Syntax Needs Adjustment
template: Python could not parse line {line}. Double-check quotes, parentheses, commas, and colons.
socratic: Which part of line {line} differs from the expected syntax?

headline: Module Not Available
template: Module `{name}` on line {line} is not available in Pycraft. Use the active robot commands and core Python tools.
socratic: Which built-in Pycraft commands can solve this task directly?

headline: `{name}` Is Not Unlocked Yet
template: BIT does not have the `{name}` capability in this area (line {line}). You will unlock `{name}` in {unlockMission}.
socratic: Which commands are listed as active in this mission header?

headline: Capitalize `{suggestion}`
template: Python is case-sensitive! On line {line}, write `{suggestion}` with a capital first letter instead of `{name}`.
socratic: How are `True`, `False`, and `None` capitalized in Python?

headline: Possible Typo in `{name}`
template: Python does not recognize `{name}` on line {line}. Did you mean `{suggestion}`?
socratic: Check the spelling of `{name}` letter by letter on line {line}.

headline: Undefined Name `{name}`
template: The variable or command `{name}` on line {line} has not been defined yet or is out of scope.
socratic: Was `{name}` assigned a value before line {line}?

headline: `.{attr}()` Is Locked Here
template: The `{object}.{attr}` capability on line {line} is not unlocked in this region/mission yet. It unlocks in {unlockMission}.
socratic: Check the unlocked command chips in the editor header.

headline: Unknown Method `.{attr}`
template: `{object}` on line {line} has no method `{attr}`. Did you mean `{object}.{suggestion}`?
socratic: Check the spelling after the dot on line {line}.

headline: Cannot Access Attribute on `None`
template: On line {line}, the value you accessed is `None` (empty), for example `scan()` on an empty tile.
socratic: What did the previous call return before line {line}?

headline: Attribute or Method Not Found
template: The object on line {line} has no attribute `{attr}`. Check the object's available commands.
socratic: Which methods belong to the object on line {line}?

headline: Cannot Add Text and Number Directly
template: On line {line}, you tried to combine text (`str`) with a number (`int`). Use `int(text)` to convert numeric text into an integer, or `str(num)` for text.
socratic: Is the value from `scan()` or `input()` still a string (`str`)?

headline: Missing Parentheses `()` on Call
template: On line {line}, you wrote `{expr}` without `()`. Add parentheses `()` so Python and BIT execute the command.
socratic: What symbols go at the end of a command to actually run it?

headline: Wrong Number of Arguments
template: The call on line {line} received the wrong number of arguments. Check how many parameters belong inside `()`.
socratic: How many inputs does this function or command expect?

headline: Value Type Cannot Be Used This Way
template: The value on line {line} cannot be called like a function or looped over directly. To loop N times, use `range(N)`.
socratic: When repeating N times in `for`, which helper wraps N?

headline: Incompatible Value Type
template: On line {line}, the value type does not match what this command expects (such as `int` vs `str` or `bool`).
socratic: Which type (`int`, `str`, or `bool`) is expected on line {line}?

headline: Text Is Not a Valid Number
template: The text `"{val}"` on line {line} is not numeric, so `int()` cannot convert it into an integer.
socratic: Make sure the text passed to `int(...)` contains only digits.

headline: Invalid Argument Value
template: The argument passed on line {line} is out of range or invalid (e.g. turn must be `"left"`, `"right"`, or `"around"`, and steps must be a positive integer).
socratic: Which valid values does the command on line {line} accept?

headline: Cannot Divide by Zero
template: On line {line}, your program tried to divide by `0`. Ensure the divisor is never zero.
socratic: Why did the divisor on line {line} evaluate to `0`?

headline: Index Out of Range
template: On line {line}, the index goes past the length of the list. Remember Python indexing starts at `0`.
socratic: How many items are in the list, and what is the largest valid index?

headline: Key Not Found
template: The key `"{val}"` on line {line} is missing from the dictionary. Check spelling or use `.get()`.
socratic: Which keys actually exist in that dictionary?

headline: Function Recursed Too Deeply
template: On line {line}, the function called itself repeatedly until reaching the depth limit (200).
socratic: Is there a stopping base case before the function calls itself again?

headline: Not Enough `input()` Answers
template: Your program on line {line} requested `input()` more times than the pre-filled answers provided.
socratic: How many times does your program call `input()`?

headline: Program Ran Too Long
template: Your program ran more than {limit} steps without stopping — the loop on line {line} may always stay `True`.
socratic: What makes the loop condition on line {line} eventually become `False`?

headline: Robot Action Limit Reached
template: BIT executed more than {limit} world actions by line {line}. Check your loop bounds so BIT does not keep moving endlessly.
socratic: Does your loop count match the puzzle grid size?
